chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
God has ordered me to love four people: Ali (peace be upon him), Salman, Abu Tharr, and Miqdad ibn al-Aswad.
ai.seo_question: Who are the four people God commanded the Prophet to love?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, this hadith underscores the divine imperative of *hubb* (love) for the Ahl al-Bayt and their loyal companions, establishing a foundational link between prophetic authority and the Imams. By including Salman, Abu Tharr, and Miqdad alongside Ali, the narration emphasizes the universal and inclusive nature of this divine love, extending beyond lineage to include those who exemplified piety and loyalty to the Prophet's message.
